other_conditions: Applicant must be a leather artisan

Applicant must belong to one of the listed sub‑castes among the scheduled castes (Arundathiyar, Chammadiya, Chamar, Chambar, Chamagar, Madar, Madig, Madiga, Mini Madig, Jambavalu, Haralayya, Machigar, Mochigar, Mochi, muchi, Telugu Mochi, kamaati mocha, Rohidas, Dhor, kakkayya, Kankayya, Samagara, Samagar, Aadhi Anddra, Aadhi Dravida, Aadhi Karnataka)
Applicant must have passed a Secondary School Leaving Certificate (SSLC), Pre‑University Courses (PUC) or hold a Degree
Annual family income must not exceed ₹30,000 in rural areas or ₹25,000 in urban areas
Applicant or family members must not have received benefits from other schemes, except training programs
Family members should not be employed in government or semi‑government organizations
benefits_summary: The full course cost is sponsored by the corporation and a stipend is provided during the training period.
